## Night brain dump

`loomctl dump` quietly parks thoughts. No immediate message is sent. At 7:00 AM, queued thoughts become one mention-safe Discord card sorted into action, idea, research, remember, worry, and other buckets. Delivered entries clear only after Discord accepts the card.

Select the **Loom personal intake** Header Auth credential and **GuildedThorn Gaming Drop Discord** before publishing. Queue is capped at 100 entries.
